data.desc: La Rosa Holdings Corp. (Nasdaq: LRHC) is expanding into AI infrastructure, including the acquisition and deployment of high-performance computing assets. The Company offers both residential and commercial real estate brokerage services, as well as technology-driven products and support for its agents and franchise partners. Its business model includes internal services for agents and external offerings for the public, spanning real estate brokerage, franchising, education and coaching, and property management.
